1. The Rusty Anchor: bar; Mags sells drinks and rumours
2. Kessler's Pawn: weapons, ammo, gear; buys loot
3. Doc Vo's Clinic: healing, medkits, stims
4. Nguyen's Noodle Bar: food; knows the drain gate code
5. Golden Carp Capsules: safehouse: capsule 12, stash locker, sleep
6. Harbor Fish Hall: night market; black-market stalls
7. Oracle kiosk: data broker; buys data shards
8. Silk, the fixer: back room of the Anchor; gives M1 and M2
9. Tank, the bouncer: guards the back room; Persuasion 2 or 50 cr
10. Petra: sanitation worker; her brother is a hostage
11. Officer Dace: runs the checkpoint; bribable
12. Mouse: street kid; vents, rooftops, gossip
13. Rivet: scavenger; sells a Drain Rats jacket
14. Skiv: Drain Rats scout watching the Pit
15. Jax: Scrap Kings recruiter; gang pass
16. Sister Lin: shrine keeper; rumours, S3
17. Storm drain: The Drains: level exit to M1
18. Scrapyard Road: the Yard: level exit to M2, past the checkpoint
19. Low Harbor Station: sealed; the Upper City later
20. Skyway service lift: up to the service deck (Hacking 1)
21. Outfall grate: into the Drains' flooded bypass; Lockpicking 1
22. Freight tunnel gate: to the Yard's rail siding; Hacking 1
23. Roof run: fire escapes; Mouse shows the way
24. Rooftop stash: neural chip; on the Golden Carp's roof
25. Girder cache: end of the Skyway service deck
26. Drowned locker: on the bed under the Tin Bridge; dive
27. Offering box: shrine; Lockpicking 2
28. Depot lockers: sanitation overalls; workers only
29. Precinct 9: MerSec; evidence terminal, Hacking 2
M1 Rat Trap: Silk: free two sanitation workers held in the Drains' pump station.
M2 Chop Job: Silk: steal the prototype nav core from the Scrap Kings' office safe.
S1 Kingmaker: Jax wants Crusher, the Scrap Kings' boss, dead. Or does he?
S2 The Ledger: Petra: the Kings' ledger names the MerSec officers on their payroll.
S3 Mouse's Debt: Mouse owes Dace 300 cr. Pay, persuade, or take the evidence from Precinct 9.
S4 Last Call: Mags: her whisky shipment went down the drain. The Rats are drinking it.
U Upper City: The station reopens after the first slice.

g.text: The drowned bottom of Meridian, under the Skyway and the Halcyon Spire.
Every NPC here can be talked to. Two exits lead to this slice's missions,
each with more than one way through.
